summary: Secret field that hides its value under live static; revealing dissolves the noise outward from the click and re-hides after 15 s.

attributes.name: secret
attributes.description: Value to hide, reveal and copy. The default is a demo key. Observed: a change replaces the displayed value.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Text beside the `API key` label while the secret is hidden. Observed.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fires on every reveal or hide, including the automatic hide after 15 s.

events.name: copy
events.description: Fires after the Copy button or `copy()` is used. `ok` is `false` when the clipboard write was rejected.

methods.description: Reveals or hides the secret. `x` is the horizontal origin of the dissolve in pixels from the left of the value.
Writes the secret to the clipboard and shows `Copied`, or `Failed` when the write is rejected.

accessibility: The secret is monospace text under a noise canvas. It is `aria-hidden` while hidden and readable by screen readers while shown.
The Reveal button's `aria-label` follows its text: `Reveal secret` or `Hide secret`.
A visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` region announces `Secret shown`, `Secret hidden`, `Copied to clipboard` and `Copy failed`; it never reads the secret.
Clicking the value area also toggles it; that area is not focusable.
motion: With reduced motion the static is frozen, revealing and hiding happen at once without the dissolve, and copying shows no green flash; the Copy label swaps without rolling.
notes: The secret is plain text in the shadow DOM and is only masked visually; scripts on the page can read it.
The `API key` label text is fixed.
When the clipboard write fails, for example outside a secure context, the button shows `Failed` instead of `Copied` and there is no green flash; `copy` still fires, with `ok: false`.
Copying selected text inside the field keeps its native `copy` event inside the shadow root, so `copy` listeners on the host only receive the element's own event with `ok` in `detail`.

data.note: Pass the value to hide as `secret`. Without it a demo API key is shown.
